Read `AGENTS.md`, local `AboutMe.md`, and `Job-Applications/[company]/job.txt`.

Select exactly one category: Senior SRE Engineer, AWS Solutions Architect, or Engineering Manager. Create or refresh only `cv.md`, `prep.md`, and `thinking.md` in that company folder. `thinking.md` is a concise decision record, not hidden reasoning. Use only supported facts, identify genuine gaps, and do not alter inputs, submit applications, or commit private files.
